source.title: In vivo acquired daptomycin resistance during treatment of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus endocarditis
source.source_type: case report / single-patient longitudinal clinical and microbiologic observation

source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: preserved as two distinct directly reported atoms; not normalized or merged

semantic_spot_checks.check: Atoms preserve emergence of daptomycin resistance during treatment without prior vancomycin and retain the authors’ unresolved-mechanism conclusion as an author conclusion.
Atoms preserve the narrative initial daptomycin MIC 0.25 mg/L and Figure 1 S1 value 0.125 mg/L as a documented source-internal discrepancy, plus 0.75 and 2 mg/L later values.
Atoms preserve day-68 switch to vancomycin/gentamicin/linezolid and subsequent negative blood cultures without assigning causality to any single agent.
Figure-derived S1/S2/S3 MICs and treatment timeline were visually inspected; Figure 1 S1 daptomycin MIC is 0.125 mg/L.
Atoms preserve that candidate-gene comparison did not explain daptomycin resistance and the molecular mechanism remained to be determined.

warnings.message: Initial daptomycin MIC differs between case-report narrative (0.25 mg/L) and Figure 1 S1 (0.125 mg/L); both are preserved.

extraction_limitations: Single-patient case report; no comparator or causal treatment-effect estimate.
The supplied source contains an unresolved initial daptomycin MIC discrepancy between narrative text and Figure 1.
The authors’ “first case” statement is a literature-positioning claim and was not independently proven by this extraction.
Atoms remain needs_review because no human reviewer identity is represented in the source-processing record.
